2607.11594.title: MAGIC: Transition-Aware Generation of Navigable Multi-Scene Game Worlds with Large Language Models
2607.11594.paper_summary: Multi-scene navigation (clearing an objective in one bounded space and then crossing a portal into the next) is a defining feature of contemporary 3D games, but authoring it is laborious: every portal must have consistent endpoints on both sides, each interior must remain navigable once it is furnished, and the resulting connectivity must be kept consistent across many files. Recent large language model (LLM) and multimodal LLM (MLLM) scene generators have made single-interior synthesis dramatically cheaper, yet they produce one scene at a time and cannot, by naive repetition, yield a connected multi-scene world. We identify three obstacles that single-scene methods leave unsolved: cross-scene consistency, in-scene navigability, and the evaluation of whether a transition actually works. We present MAGIC, a prompt-to-project system that addresses all three. MAGIC is a four-stage pipeline that turns a single natural-language prompt into a runnable multi-scene game project: it plans a shared transition-aware intermediate representation, specifies each scene while enforcing portal reachability with a flood-fill validator, generates the scenes together with their transition scripts, and combines them into one project. Because existing single-scene fidelity metrics never execute a transition, we further introduce a transition-focused evaluation agent that runs each transition in play. On a new benchmark of 100 multi-scene cases, MAGIC produces an executable project for every case and reaches 0.99 precision, 0.95 recall, and 0.96 F1 on end-to-end transition identification; stage by stage, it recovers more ground-truth portals and yields markedly more navigable layouts than an LLM baseline and Holodeck. Our code is available at https://github.com/sereneee1201/MAGIC/.
2607.11594.paper_summary_zh: 多場景導航（在一個有限空間內清除目標，然後穿越傳送門進入下一個空間）是當代3D遊戲的一個定義特徵，但創建它是繁瑣的：每個傳送門必須在兩側具有一致的端點，每個內部空間在裝修後必須保持可導航，並且產生的連接性必須在多個文件中保持一致。最近的大型語言模型（LLM）和多模態LLM（MLLM）場景生成器使得單一內部合成的成本大幅降低，但它們一次只能生成一個場景，並且無法通過簡單的重複產生一個連接的多場景世界。我們確定了單場景方法未解決的三個障礙：跨場景一致性、場景內可導航性，以及評估過渡是否實際有效。我們提出了MAGIC，一個針對這三個問題的提示到專案系統。MAGIC是一個四階段的流程，將單一自然語言提示轉換為可運行的多場景遊戲專案：它規劃一個共享的過渡感知中介表示，指定每個場景，同時使用洪水填充驗證器強制傳送門的可達性，生成場景及其過渡腳本，並將它們合併為一個專案。由於現有的單場景保真度指標從未執行過渡，我們進一步引入了一個專注於過渡的評估代理，該代理在遊玩中運行每個過渡。在一個新的100個多場景案例的基準測試中，MAGIC為每個案例生成了一個可執行的專案，並在端到端過渡識別上達到0.99的精確度、0.95的召回率和0.96的F1分數；逐階段地，它恢復了更多的真實傳送門，並產生了明顯更多可導航的佈局，超過了LLM基準和Holodeck。我們的代碼可在https://github.com/sereneee1201/MAGIC/上獲得。
